query: De novo miniprotein binders against human PD-L1 for blocking the PD-1 interaction.
_target_provenance: Target chain A is the extracellular region of human PD-L1 (UniProt Q9NZQ7, CD274_HUMAN), residues 19-238, i.e. the 'Extracellular' topological domain as annotated by UniProt (signal peptide 1-18 removed). Sequence copied verbatim from rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21; no residue was edited. Epitope residues are NOT asserted here: none has been established for this campaign, so the whole chain is offered and the API is left to choose.
